about: Hong Kong words and characters for zh-Hant-HK (src/srw64_native/zh_hant_hk.py), from Super Robot Wars Z (tools/translation/import_srwz_hk.py). terms: a mainland word (sc) becomes hk where the record's Japanese has one of jp and none of jp_not; tw is Taiwan's, for reference. Group srw64 rules are ours, kept on import. characters: Taiwan form -> Hong Kong form.

sources.franchise: zh.wikipedia.org zh-tw / zh-hk variants, read 2026-11-18: 魔神Z (無敵鐵金剛 / 鐵甲萬能俠), 蓋特機器人 / 三一萬能俠 (Getter-1 三一1號), 金剛戰神 / 巨靈神, 創聖機械天使 / 創聖大天使, 機動戰士鋼彈 / 機動戰士高達. Zambot 3, Daitarn 3 and Eureka Seven showed no regional difference and stay as they are.
